answer: Streak multipliers: identity weight = 1 + 0.1×consecutive-epoch streak, capped at 3×. Splitting into N fresh IDs resets each to 1×, so a farm needs N× the stake to match one veteran's weight. A ferrous on-chain registry logs stake and streak per ID, making copper-fast ID rotation detectable when funding traces converge. Karst-like erosion: attacker cost scales linearly with N while influence stays flat. Verdict: honest streaks compound, sybil splits don't.
